items.title: [Google Play 差评] ★1 Been playing this game for about a year
items.summary: Been playing this game for about a year but there's just too many broken promises from the dev. They promised an offline version, but I doubt it. There's less motivation to pull and whale for new characters when the devs can just change their kits whenever they want. My love for the game is gone, this new "Morimens" is nothing compared to Morimens before Arc 2 started. Everything changed when "divine realms" was added.

items.summary: New review in light of recent updates. The game has made changes towards pay2win with the endgame and the developers have repeatedly broken promises made to the community. Anybody seriously interested in this game needs to spend a little time viewing the main discord and reddit. It won't take long to find the huge number of veteran players showing their disappointment with the direction the game has been making.
